text_en: My child, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments;
text_cn: 我儿，不要忘了我的法律，该诚心恪守我的诫命，

text_en: for length of days and years of life and abundant welfare they will give you.
text_cn: 因为这样能使你延年益寿，也能增加你的康宁。

text_en: Do not let loyalty and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
text_cn: 不要让慈祥和忠实离弃你，要将她们系在你的颈上，刻在你的心版上；

text_en: So you will find favor and good repute in the sight of God and of people.
text_cn: 这样，你在天主和世人面前，必获得宠幸和恩爱。

text_en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not rely on your own insight.
text_cn: 你应全心信赖上主，总不要依赖自己的聪明；

text_en: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths.
text_cn: 应步步体会上主，他必修平你的行径。

text_en: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the Lord , and turn away from evil.
text_cn: 不要自作聪明，应敬畏上主，远避邪恶；

text_en: It will be a healing for your flesh and a refreshment for your body.
text_cn: 如此，你的身体必会康健，你的骨骼也会舒适。

text_en: Honor the Lord with your substance and with the first fruits of all your produce;
text_cn: 应以你的财物和一切初熟之物，去尊崇上主；

text_en: then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will be bursting with wine.
text_cn: 这样，你的仓廪必充满粮食，你的榨酒池必盈溢新酒。

text_en: My child, do not despise the Lord ’s discipline or be weary of his reproof,
text_cn: 我儿，不要轻视上主的惩戒，也不要厌恶他的谴责，

text_en: for the Lord reproves the one he loves, as a father the son in whom he delights.
text_cn: 因为上主谴责他所爱的，有如父亲谴责他的爱子。

text_en: Happy are those who find wisdom, and those who get understanding,
text_cn: 寻得智慧和获取睿智的人是有福的，

text_en: for her income is better than silver, and her revenue better than gold.
text_cn: 因为赚得智慧胜于赚得银钱；智慧的果实胜于纯金。

text_en: She is more precious than jewels, and nothing you desire can compare with her.
text_cn: 智慧比珍珠还要宝贵；凡你所贪求的，都不足以与她伦比。

text_en: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
text_cn: 在她右边是延年益寿，在她左边是富贵荣华。

text_en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
text_cn: 她的道路是康乐之道，她的行径是一片安宁。

text_en: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her; those who hold her fast are called happy.
text_cn: 她为掌握她的人，是一株生命树； 凡坚持她的，必将纳福。

text_en: The Lord by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens;
text_cn: 上主以智慧奠定了大地，以睿智坚定了高天；

text_en: by his knowledge the deeps broke open, and the clouds drop down the dew.
text_cn: 赖他的智识，深渊才裂口喷水，云彩才降下甘露。

text_en: My child, do not let these escape from your sight: keep sound wisdom and prudence,
text_cn: 我儿，你应保持明智和慎重，不要让她们离开你的视线：

text_en: and they will be life for your soul and adornment for your neck.
text_cn: 二者应是你心灵的生命，是你颈项的华饰；

text_en: Then you will walk on your way securely and your foot will not stumble.
text_cn: 这样，你走路必感安全，你的脚不致绊倒。

text_en: If you sit down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.
text_cn: 你若坐下，必无所恐惧；你若躺下，必睡得甘甜。

text_en: Do not be afraid of sudden panic, or of the storm that strikes the wicked;
text_cn: 你决不怕骤然而来的恐怖，也不怕恶人突然而至的摧残，

text_en: for the Lord will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being caught.
text_cn: 因为上主将要护佑你，使你的脚远离陷阱。

text_en: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in your power to do it.
text_cn: 你若有能力作到，不要拒绝向有求于你的人行善；

text_en: Do not say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again, tomorrow I will give it”—when you have it with you.
text_cn: 如果你能即刻作到，不要对你的近人说：“去！明天再来，我才给你。”

text_en: Do not plan harm against your neighbor who lives trustingly beside you.
text_cn: 几时你的近人安心与你居住，你不应暗算他。

text_en: Do not quarrel with anyone without cause, when no harm has been done to you.
text_cn: 若他人没有加害你，你不应与他无端争辩。

text_en: Do not envy the violent and do not choose any of their ways;
text_cn: 不要羡慕强暴的人，更不要选择他的任何行径，

text_en: for the perverse are an abomination to the Lord , but the upright are in his confidence.
text_cn: 因为上主厌恶乖戾（lì）的人，挚爱正直的人。

text_en: The Lord ’s curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the abode of the righteous.
text_cn: 上主诅咒恶人的住宅，祝福义人的寓所。

text_en: Toward the scorners he is scornful, but to the humble he shows favor.
text_cn: 上主嘲弄好愚弄的人，却宠爱谦卑的人。

text_en: The wise will inherit honor, but stubborn fools, disgrace.
text_cn: 智慧的人必承受尊荣，愚昧的人必蒙受羞辱。
